text:
emma: urgent: Pepper discovered the exact spot on the windowsill where dramatic pirouettes happen. video attached 
photo-bot: uploaded video: pepper_window_pirouette.mp4 (8s) 
devon: that one tiny paw flourish at 0:03 is peak performer energy. :clap: 
li: can we nominate Pepper for Employee of the Month? does doggo count? :laughing: 
cristina: support. also someone teach him the conference-room nod so he'll approve agendas. :dog2: 
ben: honestly that's better meeting attendance than half my calendar. 
emma: official proposal: bring Pepper to the next all-hands for morale. he can lead the first 5 minutes with a pirouette and treat distribution. :sparkles: 
devon: petitioning for a "bring your pet" day every quarter. 
li: +1. also request a slow-mo GIF for maximum slack gif usage. 
photo-bot: created GIF: pepper_pirouette_slo-mo.gif 
cristina: i vote we put that GIF as the reaction for all celebratory announcements. 
ben: i'll add it to my sticker pack. 
emma: small ask: anyone have extra training treats? Pepper prefers the crunchier variety. i will accept donations at my desk or via porch drop-off. :paw_prints: 
devon: i have an unopened bag of "tiny tuna crisps". dropping off tomorrow. 
li: reaction :heart: added by cristina 
emma: thanks team. Pepper sends a dignified bow and will consider freelance morale consulting. :bow:
